title: How Earth Talk Works
subtitle: Step-by-step guide to capturing field observations, interacting with GeoAI analysis, and contributing to community investigations in Rwanda.

sections.title: Capture & Submit via WhatsApp or Web
sections.content: Take a clear photograph or record a voice note of a geological specimen, rock outcrop, mineral, or hydrogeological site. Send it directly to the Earth Talk WhatsApp line or upload via the web form.

sections.title: Instant GeoAI Interpretation
sections.content: Our multimodal GeoAI analyzes the visual characteristics, generates a preliminary identification, calculates confidence ratings, and issues a digital Geoscience Passport.

sections.title: GIS Mapping & Community Investigation
sections.content: Published observations appear on the interactive Rwanda GIS map and community investigation boards where experts and peers can discuss, verify, and build consensus.
